title: 4 Lightning Bolts, 9 Lead Changes… Which Strikes First? ⚡
description:
Blue, pink, gold or mint: which bolt touches the ground first? Call it now!

Four colored leaders start on the cloud line and grow toward the ground. This is a stylized growth model, not a simulation of real lightning. Every leader gets exactly the same 30 steps per second. On each step one of its live tips, picked at random, grows 8 pixels at a random angle up to 68 degrees either side of straight down, and 12 percent of steps leave a fork behind, which becomes one more live tip. The pale circles are drifting dry-air patches: a tip inside one is stalled, and any step that lands on it is wasted. A leader with few forks drops fast but can be stopped dead by one patch; a heavily forked one spends its steps on many tips but usually has a branch that keeps going. Tips left more than 60 pixels behind their own leader's lowest tip die out, a leader keeps at most 6 live tips, and the side walls bounce tips back in. The bars on the left edge show each color's lowest tip, and the dashed line marks the current lead. The first leader to touch the ground wins, and the magnifier shows how far short the runner-up was.
Growth, picture and sound are generated by code (seed 736), with no footage, samples or stock media.
Which color did you back?
#simulation #satisfying #race
pinned_comment: Blue, pink, gold or mint: which one touches the ground first? Pick before the first fork. Same 30 steps per second for all four, and dry air stalls any tip inside it.
synthetic_media_disclosure_reason: Clearly stylized 2D animation of abstract colored lines; a stylized growth model that could not be mistaken for real footage, people, places or events.
